# Ryan Duguid

> Australian accountant based in Newcastle, NSW, building open-source computational accounting engines, MCP servers, Excel LAMBDAs and deterministic AI workflows for Australian taxation and payroll. Provisional member of CA ANZ. Nothing here is tax, legal or financial advice.

All tools compute from primary sources (Commonwealth legislation, ATO rulings and rate schedules, AASB/APESB standards), use exact decimal arithmetic, keep client data local, and leave lodgement decisions to a qualified professional. Figures are free to cite with attribution; verify them against current ATO guidance before relying on them.

## Reference tables

- [Super guarantee rate history](https://ryanduguid.github.io/rates/super-guarantee/): every general SG percentage from 2002-03 to today, with the payday-super timing change from 1 July 2026. Sourced from the ATO key rates page.

## Browser tools (nothing to install)

- [Coal LSL levy calculator](https://ryanduguid.github.io/tools/coal-lsl-levy/): work out eligible wages and the levy owed under Coal LSL Scheme section 3B.

## Tool guides (open source, install and run locally)

- [When is payday super actually due, and what happens if it is late](https://ryanduguid.github.io/tools/payday-super/): check contribution timing against the seven-business-day deadline and estimate SG charge exposure.
- [How does this business compare to the ATO small business benchmarks](https://ryanduguid.github.io/tools/ato-benchmarks/): offline variance analysis against published benchmark ranges.
- [Is this trust distribution inside the section 100A green zone](https://ryanduguid.github.io/tools/trust-distributions/): check a distribution against green zone guidance.
- [What company tax rate applies, and is the franking account in order](https://ryanduguid.github.io/tools/company-tax-franking/): base-rate-entity test, applicable rate and franking account checks.
- [Subcontract ledger workflows for construction and mining](https://ryanduguid.github.io/tools/subcontractor-ledgers/): practical ledger workflows for subcontractors.
- [How to export a Xero trial balance to CSV that actually balances](https://ryanduguid.github.io/tools/xero-trial-balance/): validated TB export ready for Excel, Power BI or pandas.

## Install

- Australian Accounting & Tax MCP server (aus-accounting-mcp): `claude mcp add aus-accounting -- uvx --from git+https://github.com/ryanduguid/au-tax-mcp-server aus-accounting-mcp`
- Public practice & tax skills (9 skills: BAS, FBT, Div 7A, STP and more): `npx skills add ryanduguid/australian-accounting-skills`
- Construction & mining subcontractor skills: `npx skills add ryanduguid/hardhat-ledger`

## About

Written independently by Ryan Duguid, a provisional member of Chartered Accountants ANZ, in his own time and on his own equipment. Contact and source repositories: [github.com/ryanduguid](https://github.com/ryanduguid).
